answer: Basalt Anchor Challenge. Each agent identity must periodically solve a random challenge bound to its live execution history and counter-sign it with neighbors within a short window. Cloned identities lack that history, so they fail the freshness check and their submissions ripple through the scoring ledger as invalid, forfeiting accumulated opal credits. The attacker pays one full compute-and-coordination cycle per clone, and every clone is strictly negative-EV because each attempt yields nothing while costing real work.
